English: Silkworm Box
The first step for any silk nomad: a simple, mobile box for silkworms, easily carried by the clan. Enables basic silk cultivation and begins the journey toward luxury production.
Spinning Frame
A portable wooden frame for spinning silk threads, used by the clans laborers. Improves silk output and provides the basis for further textile work.
Weavers Hut
A sturdy felt tent dedicated to weaving, staffed by skilled artisans. This marks a leap in the clans ability to process silk and support a larger population.
Dye Bath Room
A large, semi-permanent tent structure with dye vats, allowing the clan to color silk in vibrant hues. Greatly increases the value of silk goods and attracts traders.
Woven Silk Pavilion
A grand tented pavilion for showcasing and refining finished silks. Advanced looms and experienced weavers gather here, marking the clan as a center of silk craftsmanship.
Fine Cloth Hall
A semi-permanent wooden structure, lined with silk, where master weavers teach apprentices and produce high-quality cloth for trade and tribute.
Patterned Silk Chamber
A lavish tented chamber for weaving complex patterns and unique designs, drawing merchants and dignitaries from afar. The clan becomes renowned for its artistry.
Master Weavers Room
A prestigious mobile chamber reserved for the most skilled weavers. Here, luxury commissions are created for sultans and emperors, amplifying the clans influence.
Imperial Silk Hall
A magnificent, semi-permanent palace tent adorned with golden silk tapestries. Imperial buyers flock here, cementing the clans status as the foremost silk producers of the steppe.
Byzantine Silk Guild
A legendary association of master weavers, merchants, and silk lords, with its own laws and privileges. The Silk Guild serves as a diplomatic hub, uniting clans and impressing foreign courts.
